item1.title: World Hemophilia Day Celebration 2024
item1.excerpt: Join us in celebrating World Hemophilia Day with special events and activities for patients and families.
item1.content:
We are thrilled to announce our upcoming World Hemophilia Day celebration! This year, our focus is on 'Equitable Access for All', emphasizing the importance of ensuring that every person with a bleeding disorder has access to proper care and treatment.

The event will feature a series of engaging activities, including:
- Educational seminars led by top hematologists
- Interactive workshops for children and parents
- A community walk to raise awareness
- Storytelling sessions where patients share their inspiring journeys

Join us on April 17th at the Main Conference Hall. Together, we can build a stronger, more supportive community. Your presence matters!

item2.title: New Treatment Program Launched
item2.excerpt: We are excited to announce a new comprehensive treatment program for hemophilia patients across all provinces.
item2.content:
The Birjand Hemophilia Society is proud to launch a groundbreaking treatment program designed to improve the quality of life for patients nationwide. This initiative aims to bridge the gap in medical services between major cities and remote provinces.

Key features of the program include:
- Mobile clinics visiting underserved areas
- Subsidized access to the latest clotting factor concentrates
- Telemedicine consultations for patients in rural regions
- Specialized training for local healthcare providers

This program represents a significant milestone in our mission to provide comprehensive care. We are committed to ensuring that no patient is left behind due to geographical or financial barriers.

item3.title: Educational Workshop for Families
item3.excerpt: Learn about hemophilia management and care techniques in our upcoming educational workshop series.
item3.content:
Empowering families is at the heart of what we do. We are organizing a series of educational workshops specifically designed for parents and caregivers of children with hemophilia.

These workshops will cover essential topics such as:
- Home infusion techniques and safety
- Managing bleeds and emergencies
- Psychological support and coping strategies
- Nutrition and physical therapy

Expert nurses and counselors will be available to answer your questions and provide hands-on training. Don't miss this opportunity to gain valuable knowledge and connect with other families facing similar challenges.

item4.title: Breakthrough in Hemophilia Research
item4.excerpt: Recent research shows promising results in new treatment methods for hemophilia patients.
item4.content:
A recent study published in the Journal of Hematology has unveiled promising new developments in hemophilia gene therapy. The research, which included participants from our own registry, indicates that a single treatment could potentially provide long-term protection against bleeding episodes.

This breakthrough offers hope for a functional cure, reducing the need for frequent factor replacement therapy. While further trials are needed, these initial results are a beacon of hope for the entire community.

We will continue to monitor these developments closely and advocate for the accessibility of these cutting-edge treatments as they become available.

item5.title: Annual Patient Support Conference
item5.excerpt: Join us for our annual conference dedicated to supporting hemophilia patients and their families.
item5.content:
Our Annual Patient Support Conference is back! This two-day event brings together patients, healthcare professionals, and advocates from across the country to discuss the latest advancements in care and share experiences.

Highlights of the conference include:
- Keynote speeches by renowned international experts
- Panel discussions on patient rights and advocacy
- Networking opportunities
- An exhibition of the latest medical technologies

This is a unique platform to learn, share, and advocate for a better future. Registration is now open for all members.

item6.title: Free Medical Checkup Campaign
item6.excerpt: Free medical checkups and consultations available for all registered hemophilia patients this month.
item6.content:
As part of our ongoing commitment to preventative care, we are launching a 'Free Medical Checkup Month'. All registered members of the society are invited to visit our designated centers for a comprehensive health assessment.

The checkup includes:
- Joint health assessment
- Inhibitor screening
- Dental checkup
- General physical examination

Early detection of issues can significantly improve long-term health outcomes. We encourage everyone to take advantage of this free service. Please contact your local center to book an appointment.

aboutPage.title: About Us
aboutPage.history_p1: South Khorasan Hemophilia Society began its informal activities in the Spring of 2002 as the 'Hemophilia Branch of Special Patients'.
aboutPage.history_p2: Following the establishment of South Khorasan province and addressing numerous medical and welfare needs of patients, the Birjand representative office of the Iran Hemophilia Society officially started its operations in 2004 under its supervision.
aboutPage.mission_text: From the beginning, with the support of the noble and charitable people of the province, the society has worked to reduce the problems of hemophilia patients and provide them with a dignified life, ensuring that no patient in South Khorasan feels alone.
aboutPage.nature_text: South Khorasan Hemophilia Society is a non-governmental, non-profit, and charitable organization serving as the representative office of the Iran Hemophilia Society. All activities are conducted within the country's legal framework with official permits.
aboutPage.nature_team: Alongside patients, families, physicians, donors, and volunteers, we strive to provide a safe, hopeful, and sustainable platform for improving the quality of life for our patients.

activity4.desc: Academic, vocational, and social empowerment for patients, especially children and adolescents.

activity5.title: Counseling
activity5.desc: Addressing mental and psychological issues through counseling and emotional support.

activity6.title: Awareness
activity6.desc: Increasing public awareness and promoting a culture of empathy and support for patients.

aboutPage.quote: We believe hemophilia is not just a disease; it is a path that, with awareness, support, and empathy, can be traveled with hope and peace.
aboutPage.donation_text: Since our budget is funded by voluntary donations from charitable individuals, your contribution can play an effective role in providing medicine and treatment.
aboutPage.closing: South Khorasan Hemophilia Society strives to be the voice of hemophilia patients in the province and ease the path of their lives.
aboutPage.footer_quote: Life flows with hope; and we stand by the patients.
